card.title: StudyBud
card.subtitle: AI-Powered Document Analysis & Quiz Generation
card.summary: AI-powered tool for generating summaries and quizzes from documents. Features advanced NLP techniques for text extraction from PDF and DOCX files, integrated with OpenAI's language models.

detail.overview: StudyBud was my final year project, built to help students get more out of their study materials. Users upload PDF or DOCX files, and it uses NLP and GPT-based models to generate summaries and quizzes for revision.

problem.title: Challenge: Reliable Document Processing
problem.issue: PDFs with complex layouts or scanned content often broke extraction.
problem.impact: Low quality input reduced the accuracy of summaries and quizzes.

solution.title: Solution: Optimized Extraction Pipeline
solution.implementation: Adopted PyMuPDF (fast, reliable) and docx2txt after library comparison. Added document chunking and tokenization to handle large files.
solution.result: Extraction accuracy improved from ~70% to ~95%, with smooth performance even on 10MB+ files.

problem.title: Challenge: API Costs & Rate Limits
problem.issue: Heavy use of OpenAI API caused latency and budget concerns.
problem.impact: Processing could take 30s+ and exceed project resource limits.

solution.title: Solution: Caching & Prompt Optimization
solution.implementation: Implemented Redis caching, batched requests, and optimized prompts to reduce token usage.
solution.result: Reduced response time to ~3s and API costs by ~60% while maintaining output quality.
